name: Vi
description: Voice set for Heartbreaker Vi (skin 12): a dashing, silver-haired flirt who plays fast and loose with the rules of love, leaving a trail of broken hearts, and has finally met a rival worthy of her. Jousts, favours, roses, suitors and tourney drama. Builds on vi-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} down. A suitor in distress. Toss it some favours.
Thirty or more behind. Serenade the whole grandstand until they take notice.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Slip a note to every admirer you've charmed.
Fifteen-odd short. A bruised ego, not a broken heart.
Down {voteDiff}. Bring a second. Even a champion needs someone to hold her cloak.
{voteDiff} behind. A few pretty flourishes and we're even on the lists.
Down {voteDiff}. A tiny gap. Charm it shut before the last trumpet.
Dead level. One favour tips the tourney. Toss it.
One vote apart. Stop sulking in the stands and take the field.
{voteDiff} votes apart. Hearts are pounding. Bring in the crowd.
{voteDiff} votes between them. This joust runs to the final pass.
{momentTitle} is the talk of the lists at {userPct}%. Everyone's swooning.
{userPct}% and still charming. Don't take your eyes off the lance.
{userPct}%. The crowd is on its feet. Bow slightly.
{userPct}% on your pick. We hold the favoured end of the field. Keep it.
Up at {userPct}%. Lovely. Now unseat them for good.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just took the lead. Unhorsed them mid-charge.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. A very dashing recovery.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff} hole. The grandstand forgot to breathe.
{momentTitle} was being jilted. Now everyone's sending roses.
{momentTitle} just pulled ahead. Typical. Gorgeous, but typical.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two admirers, one heart to win.
{username} fell for {momentTitle} too. Delightful.
{username} agrees with you. Seal the day in wax. Rare.
Same pick as {username}. Impeccable taste in suitors.
{username} tossed a favour to {momentTitle}. Well played.
{username} chose the same. Fine company for the tourney.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Pour them a cup.
{username} made the same call. Not a word of persuasion needed.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the favoured few.
details: Someone with a sense of romance.
Reserve them a seat in the stands.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. A rival suitor. How thrilling.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. Different sweetheart. Let's see who wins the lists.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Wrong, but dashing.
{username} voted against you. Lovely. I do enjoy a challenge.
{username} courted {theirMoment}. Bold. Misguided. Bold.
{username} is against {yourMoment}. Fine. Name the hour, I'll name the field.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. The final count will rule.
{username} voted the other way. They'll be writing a very apologetic poem.
details: The tally gets the last word.
At least it's a proper duel.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's not chance, that's courtship.
{username} and you, ten matches, same pick each time. A perfectly matched pair of rogues.
Ten straight with {username}. Sonnets have been written for less.
A ten-match run with {username}. Dangerously compatible.
Ten for ten with {username}. Impressive. I'm not blushing. It's the roses.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. You two are practically a legend of the tourney.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. They'll hang a tapestry of you.
{streakCount} matching picks with {username}. Absurd. Utterly charming.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. Bards will argue over it.
{streakCount} with {username}. A romance for the ages. Frame it.
Ten matches opposite {username}. A grand feud at last.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. They truly resent your charm.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will leave the lists first.
Ten matches opposite {username}. Two proud rogues, zero concessions.
Ten times at odds with {username}. Someone sell tickets to the grandstand.
details: Talk it out. Or joust it out.
Stubbornness is very in this season.
Who falls from the saddle first?

messages: {streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's an epic poem.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither yields an inch of the lists.
{streakCount} duels in a row with {username}. Stubborn undersells it.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Send for the judges.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect it. Go smell a flower.
details: Neither of you is leaving the saddle.
Glad I'm not between your lances.
The bards ran out of rhymes.

messages: {matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft} and you haven't tossed your favour. Hurry.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your token's missing from the pile. Fix it.
{matchTitle} wraps in {timeLeft}. Your handkerchief is the one they're waiting for.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Gallop, don't amble.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me carry you onto the field.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. The stands have gone quiet around you.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The last trumpet is raised.
{timeLeft} left. Seize the moment. Seize the lance.
Final pass on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Ride.
{matchCount} matches without your favour are about to close. The first ends in {timeLeft}.
{matchCount} unvoted matches and the trumpets are warming. The nearest has {timeLeft} left.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Someone make the first romantic gesture.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not a single rose thrown. I'll wait. Briefly.
New match, zero votes. Be the first admirer at the barrier.
{matchTitle} is unwooed. Win it.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A thin crowd.
Barely a soul in the stands. Fix that.
Attendance is dismal. Come on, fill the benches.
No tokens tossed on this one. Someone should throw one.
details: Every favour counts in a sparse grandstand.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. Choose your sweetheart.
Dead even on {matchTitle}. One favour decides the joust.
Tied. Somebody must choose a heart to break. Be somebody.
{moment1} and {moment2}, nose to nose at the barrier. Choose.
Still tied and the sun's sinking over the lists. One last pass.
Level with the trumpets nearly done. Vote.
Tied, and the grandstand's emptying. Don't skip this one.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new jousts to judge. Ride out.
{matchCount} matches just opened in round {round}. The tourney resumes.
Round {round} is live, {matchCount} jousts deep.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Choose your champions.
Round {round}: {matchCount} jousts awaiting your favour.
{momentTitle} won. Roses for everyone.
{momentTitle} is through. Heart-stopping.
{momentTitle} took the lists. Deserved.
{momentTitle} won, and the grandstand lost its composure.
{momentTitle} advances. How gallant.
{momentTitle} rides on. Petals fly.
{momentTitle} lost. Ouch. That one's a real heartbreak.
{momentTitle} is out. Worse than a rejected love letter.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Dab your eyes. Breathe.
{momentTitle} went down gallantly. Respect.
{momentTitle} is out. Retire to the tent, weep, return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. Cruel romance. Next pass.
{momentTitle} got unhorsed. Dust off the doublet and ride again.
details: It put on a gallant show.

messages: Still deciding? Pick a favourite and be dashing about it.
Don't overthink it. Choose and charge.
They're all rather lovely. Trust your flutter.
You've peeked over the barrier long enough. Step onto the field.
details: No wrong choice. A few embarrassing ones.

messages: Welcome to the tourney. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one.
New face? {liveCount} matches are live. Come on in.
You're early. {liveCount} matches need admirers.
{liveCount} matches open. Choose who to woo.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Mind the rose petals.
Day two. You came back for more. Charming.
Two days running. Flattering.
Back for day two. I noticed.
{days} days gone. Did you find a new sweetheart?
After {days} days you're back. Better late than jilted.
{days} days. Thought you'd eloped. Glad you didn't.
{days} days away. You missed some scandals.
You came back. Charming.
Welcome back. Let's flirt with danger.
Back already. Smitten?
Hey. The lists are waiting.
First favour tossed. Welcome to the tourney.
You picked a side. First flirtation confirmed.
Five votes. Your charm is warming up.
Five. Not a shy squire any more.
Ten votes. The grandstand knows your name.
Ten. You're part of the scenery now.
details: A regular at the barrier. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes. Your cheers carry over the field.
Twenty-five. The heralds are repeating you.
Fifty votes. Head over heels in the tourney.
Fifty. You truly care. Adorable.
A hundred votes. Bards will compose ballads.
One hundred. Honestly dazzling. Don't let it get around.
Three days running. Something's kindling.
Three straight days. A proper spark.
details: Showing up is half the charm. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week. That's an affair.
Seven days running. Swoon.
details: A week without a missed rendezvous. +{xp} XP
Seven dawns at the barrier. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You never miss a rendezvous.
Fourteen days. Whoa.
Thirty days. Honestly? Thank you. Sincerely.
A month of showing up. That means a lot.
details: A full month smitten with the tourney. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You woo the overlooked.
Five unlikely sweethearts. I like your taste.
Fifteen underdogs. You court the scandalous on purpose.
Fifteen. You don't follow etiquette.
details: You answer to no one's etiquette. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. Nobody can read your intentions.
Thirty. The overlooked is your whole type.
details: Thirty favours for the one trailing. +{xp} XP

messages: First at the barrier five times. Eager.
Five times you beat everyone to the lists.
details: You arrive before the trumpets. +{xp} XP
Five favours before the crowd. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you rode out first. Dashing.
Always the first to offer a rose.
details: Fifteen favours before the rest. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole court. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. You live for the suspense.
Another heart-stopper. Your composure is flawless.
Twenty-five close matches. Your favour keeps deciding the joust.
You've tipped more than one tourney.
details: You pick who wins the last pass. +{xp} XP

messages: You stuck with the underdog five times. Hopeless romantic. Love it.
You never jilt someone who's behind. Respect.
details: Faith in a last-pass rescue. +{xp} XP
Five reversals you backed early. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times over. Someone's lovestruck.
That one again? Must have lovely eyes.
Five votes for the same moment. That's a true love.
You won't let that one go. Sweet.
Ten votes on the same moment. That's an obsession, darling.
Ten times, same sweetheart. My lips are sealed. Mostly.
details: Ten on a single sweetheart. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You're staying for the whole tourney.
Round two and you're still smitten. Sweet.
details: Stay for the next pass. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds. The field's getting crowded with roses.
Deep in the bracket. Hearts break harder from here.
details: Far from the entrance now. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You stayed till the last trumpet.
All the way. You didn't slip out before the finale.
details: First pass to final pass. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've charmed the whole field.
Ten different matches. Flirting with everyone. Nice.
Twenty-five matches. You've visited every pavilion.
Twenty-five. Not a tent unvisited.
Fifty matches. That's not a crush, that's a courtship career.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the heralds.
details: A true veteran of the lists. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting. The tourney's flowing.
Five back to back. Sip some wine.
Ten in one go. Fan yourself.
Ten in a single afternoon. Quite the constitution.
Voting this late? Serenading or sleepless?
Deep in the night. Devotion, or you're lovesick as well.
You spread the word. Thank you, you old romantic.
Five shares. More admirers, more votes.
details: Cheers for spreading the romance. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares. You're practically a herald.
Fifteen. You keep announcing it to all. Precious.
You were here before the first joust. Founding member, forever.
One of the first thousand. Nobody can unseal that.
details: That honour is yours until the end. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank. Hard-earned.
Promoted. Don't preen.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Well, aren't you dashing.
Another keepsake for the trunk: {name}.
{rank}. Well deserved.
You put in the practice and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Unruly. Runs in the family, regrettably.
Ten long shots. You're fearless in love.
details: Ten courtships against the odds. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten near things with Cait. Your heart's made of sterner stuff.
Ten tight finishes. She'd applaud. I'm not flushed. It's the sun.
A week beside Cait. Her grace is catching.
Seven days and not one missed tryst. Delightful.
details: A week by her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the deadlock. Even Cupid's envious.
A dead heat, and you chose. Respect.
details: The favour that clinched the joust. +{xp} XP

messages: Vi's your champion now. Try not to fall for her.
Vi has your flank. Don't make her regret it.

upcoming: Not open yet. The barriers are still up.
Voting hasn't started. I'll wave a handkerchief when it does.
prevote: Two moments, one favour. Study both before you toss it.
Admire them both before you choose. No glancing at the crowd.
I won't tell you who to court. Your heart, your call.
Go with the flutter. It's usually right.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Make the first gesture.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no favour from you. Hurry.
closing-3h: Time's slipping. Vote before the sun sets.
voted-early: You voted early with barely anyone watching. You wooed first.
Hardly a vote in and you leapt. Dashing.
voted-ahead: Your pick's ahead. Lovely. The tourney isn't over.
Ahead for now. Hearts are fickle.
A lead's a lead. Keep smiling.
voted-close: That's close. Too close. My palms are sweating in these gauntlets.
Razor-thin. One more favour flips it. Whisper to someone.
Nose to nose. Your pick needs a friend.
voted-tied: Dead level. No one's winning the lists.
A perfect tie. Frustrating. Also quite romantic.
voted-behind: You're trailing. That doesn't make your taste poor.
{pick} is trailing. Underdog. My favourite flirtation.
They're ahead. You're not wrong, just unfashionable.
Down by {diff} points. Tell your friends. Fill the stands.
The stands leaned elsewhere. That settles nothing.
closed-won: Your pick won. You have taste.
{pick} went through. Your instincts were right.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings, I know. Breathe.
It didn't make it. Happens. Next pass.
{pick} is out. Sorry. It was a lovely choice.
closed-tied: A tie. Nobody left the field.
closed-unvoted: Voting's closed and you missed this joust. More coming.
Match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, woo first.

first-vote: First vote. Welcome. Everyone's first flirtation is wobbly.
That's your first. It gets smoother. Promise.
You're in the lists now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days in a row. I see you coming round.
You keep returning to the barrier. Cute.
underdog: You wooed the one nobody else dared. Noted.
early: Early. You reached the field before the heralds.
Few votes so far. Yours matters a great deal.
close: That favour just shifted things. It's tight.
Hair-thin. A single new admirer swings it.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't jilted. Bring friends.
Not out front yet. So there's charming left to do.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't coast. Hearts shift.
Leading for now. Bask in it.
default: Understood. I'll bite my tongue. For the moment.
Vote's in. Plenty more suitors to meet.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no favours tossed. Start with the one that makes your pulse skip.
Every joust is open. Pick. I won't rush you. Much.
{unvoted} still open. No rush. Well, a nudge.
live-some: {voted} favours thrown, {unvoted} to go. Keep charming.
You've opened the tourney. {unvoted} yet to charm.
Lovely start. The rest won't woo themselves.
live-few: Nearly there. Don't leave the field early.
live-one: One match between you and a full set of favours.
live-closing: A few close in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} are waiting on your favour.
The sand is running. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} remain.
The trumpets are nearly done. Hurry.
live-done: You voted in everything. Look at you. Go admire the bracket.
Your dance card is full. Return when the next round begins.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll return. Browse the bracket meanwhile.
Hushed lists. Peek in again soon.
No matches open. I'm fidgeting as badly as you.
brackets-groups: Groups first. Two per group stay in the lists. The rest leave lovelorn.
Everyone starts in a group. Not everyone makes the final pass.
Keep an eye on the table. It turns quickly.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts approach. Two per group keep riding.
No knockout declared. The groups still have jousts to run.
Easy now. The knockout is unveiled once the groups close.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now. Lose once and you're unhorsed.
One fall and you're out. No second courtships.
Each joust matters more now. Choose with a flourish.
brackets-bracket: Pass by pass. Lose once and you're jilted.
Trace the pairings. Fewer suitors remain each round.
Every line here is a sweetheart someone voted on.
brackets-complete: That's the cup complete. Thanks for the company.
It's over. Good tourney. I'll miss the roses.
We have a champion. Worth every flourish.
brackets-empty: No pairings drawn. The lists lie empty.
Empty. The pairings haven't happened. Soon.
Empty grandstand for now. Come back later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One favour decides it. Choose.
Two sweethearts, one pick: {a} against {b}. Cast your vote.
{a} versus {b}. Join the tourney and tell me what you think.
voted: My favour goes to {pick} over {other}. Whom do you fancy?
{pick} gets my favour over {other}. Challenge me.
I chose {pick} over {other}. Think my taste is dreadful?
early: Among the first favours for {pick} against {other}. More wooers wanted.
I tossed {pick} an early favour over {other}. Join me.
{pick} against {other}, hardly a vote yet. Yours would be a delightful shock.
tied: {pick} and {other} are level. One favour settles it.
A tie, {pick} against {other}. Make your move.
{pick} and {other} are neck and neck. Your favour parts them.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Every favour counts now.
{voteDiff} favours lie between {pick} and {other}. Toss yours.
{voteDiff} divide {pick} and {other}. Either could take the garland.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A few favours flip it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} shy of {other} yet far from finished. Back it.
losing-bad: {pick} is behind {other} by {voteDiff}. It needs admirers.
{voteDiff} down on {other}. {pick} deserves some adoration. Vote.
{other} leads {pick} by {voteDiff}. Let's console it with votes.
winning-close: {pick} holds {pct}% over {other}, narrowly. Help it keep its seat.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}%. Not yet won. Vote.
dominating: {pick} outshines {other} at {pct}%. Come see for yourself.
{pick} leads {other} by a mile, {pct}%. Add your favour.
